content:
Amazon's Prime Day Early Fall Sale event has officially kicked off, featuring new size discounts, a $50 markdown on the just-released Mac Studio, and up to $150 off multiple M5 MacBook Air models. We're also tracking deep $500 price cuts on both Silver and Space Black 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro variants, ongoing clearance deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3, a massive haul of TV deals, and fresh discounts on accessories from brands like Twelve South and Anker. All the top picks below.

M5 Pro MacBook Pro in Silver and Space Black now $500 off at Amazon

While there are still a few solid low prices on the latest M5 MacBook Air, we wanted to highlight Amazon's $500 price drop on this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro—both Space Black and Silver models are now available at this steep discount.

Amazon is now shipping the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,699, equipped with 24GB RAM and 2TB of storage.

This is the lowest price we've tracked in several months, and both Space Black and Silver variants are currently in stock—the latter of which rarely sees discounts.

It's $500 off its $3,199 list price. As mentioned previously, with many tech deals these days simply bringing the cost back down to the older MSRP, this discount comes in at $100 below even the pre-Apple-price-hike price from late June.

Lowest-price 15-inch M5 MacBook Air now $100 off, 24GB model $150 off

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (list $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 (list $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,849 (list $1,999)

Rare clearance deal lands on Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 in small/medium, more models up to $200 off

While the brand-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 is officially on sale with early bird savings across the lineup, Amazon is also offering deals well below the Ultra 4 on the previous generation, still-impressive Apple Watch Ultra 3.

The Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the stylish Milanese band remains the standout deal—originally $899, now nearly $200 off. While it's the most notable offering in this clearance batch, several other configurations also joined the price drops this morning.

However, worth noting: the other configurations have now been priced to align with the Milanese Loop with Premium Metal Weave options. The catch is the nearly $200 markdown only applies to the large size, while medium and small sizes both see $100 discounts—rare finds for these in-demand medium configurations:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Alpine Loop $699 (list $799) → $699 (list $799) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $799 (list $899) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Trail Loop $699 (list $799) | Small

Again, the Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the large Milanese band remains the best value, but given how scarce medium-size deals can be, we felt these were worth flagging.

Apple's brand-new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio now $50 off at Amazon

Beyond the return of early bird deals on the more affordable M6 Mac mini, those looking to upgrade to Apple's recently released all-new 2026 Mac Studio can now grab one at a new low price at Amazon.

Amazon is now shipping the brand-new M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and 512GB storage for $2,449.

It's $50 off its $2,499 list price. While not a massive markdown, early upgraders will appreciate saving $50—a dollar more than the pre-order discount.

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (list $2,499)

Amazon hasn't officially stocked prior Mac Studio configurations previously, making the pricing trends on this machine difficult to predict. So far it's seeing early bird deals alongside the new M6 Mac mini, but Amazon tends to be more aggressive early in an Apple product's lifecycle, making it hard to say whether this pro-grade machine will see further markdowns around Prime Day and Black Friday. Seeing discounts close to $100 later this year isn't entirely out of the question, but we can't say for sure at this point.

Either way, early buyers can save a bit; and the M6 Mac mini early bird deals have also returned on select configurations for those who don't need the M5 Max and 36GB RAM:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (list $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (list $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (list $1,299)
